title: Skeleton Wizard and Pink Creature
description: A skeletal wizard in a hooded blue robe with pink accents stands with arms outstretched on a moss-covered shipwreck perched atop a rocky outcrop in turbulent waters. A large pink tentacled creature with big black eyes and sharp teeth clings to the bow of the wreck, set against a swirling cosmic vortex of green and purple in a starry night sky.
prompt: A skeletal wizard wearing a tall pointed hood and flowing dark blue robe with pink inner lining stands with arms raised in a mystical gesture on an old wooden shipwreck covered in green moss and barnacles. The wreck rests on jagged rocks in churning ocean waves. A large pink tentacled monster with huge glossy black eyes, sharp teeth, and multiple limbs clings to the front of the ship. Dramatic swirling green and purple cosmic vortex fills the starry night sky behind them, with glowing stars and nebulae, fantasy style, cinematic lighting, detailed digital art.
